civilizationTiers.name: Planetary Civilization
civilizationTiers.description: Unify settlement science into a body of knowledge capable of sustaining an autonomous world.
civilizationTiers.milestone: Maintain a fully staffed, food-positive colony for one hour.
civilizationTiers.unlock: Planetary autonomy and Dyson swarm planning

civilizationTiers.name: Stellar Civilization
civilizationTiers.description: Develop the field physics and stellar engineering needed to capture the output of a star.
civilizationTiers.milestone: Complete a Dyson swarm at one colony.

civilizationTiers.name: Galactic Civilization
civilizationTiers.description: Solve autonomous replication and coordination across an inhabited galaxy.
civilizationTiers.milestone: Bring replication networks online at three stars in one galaxy.
